title: The APT Foundation donates $20,000 to Australian flood support
author: Ian
body:
The recent devastating flood events in Queensland and NSW have affected thousands, displacing people from their homes, schools and farms. The APT Foundation have donated $20,000 to the cause.

The donation has been split between two charities as follows:

$10,000 will be donated towards Rural Aid - Rural Aid are at the ready to help farmers and their families in their recovery through wellbeing, financial and fodder assistance. Australians need our farmers and right now our farmers need us.

$10,000 will be donated towards the Salvation Army - The Salvation Army are supporting first responders and evacuees with meals (more than 6,500), emotional and practical support. The Salvation Army will also remain in communities for the long term to ensure the local communities impacted by these floods are supported through the recovery and rebuild phases.

If you wish to support any of these organisations, then you can do so via the below.
